column1: File notes: These data underlie a joint effort by the Bureau of Economic Analysis and the Bureau of Labor Statistics to produce a total economy production account resulting in the paper "Eldridge, Lucy P., Corby Garner, Thomas F. Howells, Brian C. Moyer, Matthew Russell, Jon D. Samuels, Erich H. Strassner, and David B. Wasshausen. "Toward a BEA-BLS integrated industry-level production account for 1947–2016." In Measuring Economic Growth and Productivity, pp. 221-249. Academic Press, 2020."

column3: These data are experimental in nature and their quality is significantly less than the current version of the data included in the official BEA-BLS  Integrated Industry Level Production Account due to the many assumptions that were needed to conduct research on the long time series. See the paper for details on the data construction.  These data pulled as of October 26, 2020.
